title: Its chaos , i made a map with 49 snakes :O
author: Affectionate_Fact854
selftext:
So day 3 , what i have done so far is 

settings has 4 presets of how snakes are drawn   
each is a different godot mesh optimization method   
all of them was tested with profilers for vertexes, draw calls against the cpu and gpu work done 

so for me i play potato style , so i take the preset that makes the snakes apear basic 

but its up to the player !!!!

  
im still playing around with camera angle and the shader used 

  
snakes now grows wider in diameter alongside length   
  
3 game modes   
normal   
cluster orbs   
and   
death match (the dome shrinks every 1 minute till the last snake stands)!  
  
going to make a couple of more experimental maps   
  
but optimization part is done and dusted !!!  
my 14 year old pc with 8gig ram can now handle recording a video and playing with 49 enemies on the map :D   
  
  
lets go weekend :O

comments.author: Affectionate_Fact854
comments.body:
So to keep the next post for tomorrow I'll leave day 4 here as a comment!!

Having such a blast with this game concept 
Fixed some bugs that creeper up when the snake gets massive 

Optimized orbs spawn to have a hard limit 
Snake drop orbs merge if In close proximity also now 

Started playing around with new mechanics 
Added a galactic coin currency you gain by winning a death match game 

Created a shop to buy snake skins using this in game galactic coin currency 

Added (experimental) 
3 additional game modes to pick from 

Added a new method to hold down a key and move camera around

Fully implemented the future sdk 

Prepared the test export 


Tomorrow after final personal additional playtesting i will upload the first public playtest!
